subject: Reliability review + proposal for Premium Assurance tier (FinMetric renewal)
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <cto@finmetric.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@finmetric.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Spike in 95th pct latency + upcoming renewal

Mina —

We saw a noticeable jump in p95 latency across our prod traffic after your 12/30 model rollout. That spike has been intermittent but has affected a handful of customer-facing endpoints (see attached latency_report_q4.csv). Our SREs are tracking increased tail latency correlated with long context requests.

Renewal is due in March and we are evaluating two things: 1) whether we can lock in a stronger latency SLO for the next term and 2) whether Redwood will consider a one-time goodwill credit for the incidents in December.

We value the throughput you provide, but we need assurance — either a concrete SLA addendum or a discounted path to your Premium Assurance tier that includes regional failover and tighter p95 SLOs. Can we schedule a reliability review this week?

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Cho
CTO, FinMetric

Attachment: latency_report_q4.csv (CSV, 432KB)
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Cho <cto@finmetric.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Spike in 95th pct latency + upcoming renewal

Hi Daniel — thank you for the report and the heads-up. I’m sorry to see FinMetric was impacted over the holidays. We take tail latency seriously.

Proposed immediate steps:
- Schedule a 60-min reliability review this Thursday (Jan 14). I’ll bring our runtime team and Rishi (postmortem lead).
- We’ll run a targeted KV/prefix cache audit and share mitigations within 48 hours of the call.
- I’ll put a draft SLA addendum on the table that specifies a p95 latency target and remediation credits for regressions.

Commercially, we can propose a conditional upgrade path to our Premium Assurance tier (regional failover + 99.99% uptime target + 150ms p95 target for production routes). I’ll need to confirm pricing and an exception credit for the December incidents with Finance.

I’ve pulled the latency CSV into our tracker. Can you confirm a few representative request IDs (top 5 by latency) so we can correlate logs?

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — charge@redwood.ai

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Spike in 95th pct latency + upcoming renewal

Timing: I can own the reliability review and remediation plan. Quick notes for the call:
- Ask FinMetric for sample request IDs + traces; we’ll run an end-to-end KV cache hit-rate analysis and model decode profiling.
- We should offer an immediate config mitigation: reduce max_batch_size for affected routes and enable per-route KV caching for 7 days while we root-cause. That usually brings p95 down quickly.
- On credits: recommend approving a single-month service credit (up to 10% of Jan invoice) as a gesture. Anything larger needs finance sign-off from Ben.

I’ll prepare a short runbook and a draft remediation timeline to share on the call.

—Rishi
Principal SRE, Redwood Serving Runtime
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Cho <cto@finmetric.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Reliability review notes + commercial proposal (SLA addendum draft attached)

Daniel — thanks again for the call earlier. Recap and next steps below.

Operational recap (actions we executed during the call):
- Temporary config change: reduced max_batch_size on two high-latency routes (applied 01/14 09:20 PST). Observed immediate p95 improvement in the call sampling.
- KV cache tuning applied to user prefixes with long contexts.
- We’ll run a deeper profiling pass on model attention patterns this week.

Commercial proposal (to unblock renewal conversations):
1) One-time customer goodwill credit: 10% credit on your January invoice, applied at renewal if you proceed at current commitment level.
2) SLA addendum: attached draft (SLA_addendum_draft_v2.pdf) that defines a Production Latency SLO: 150ms p95 for prioritized routes, with a credit schedule tied to measured violations.
3) Premium Assurance path: a 6-month pilot of our Premium Assurance tier (regional failover + 99.99% uptime + quarterly reliability reviews). Pricing: baseline uplift of 22% on committed spend with a pilot-friendly cap (we can convert to reserved capacity pricing if you like).

Ask from FinMetric: (a) confirm which routes to include in the p95 target (b) approve the 10% provisional credit (c) sign the attached addendum to proceed with the pilot.

Attachments: SLA_addendum_draft_v2.pdf

If you’re comfortable, I’ll route the addendum to Legal/Procurement and Ben will finalize pricing. Happy to jump back on a quick call.

Regards,
Mina
From: Daniel Cho <cto@finmetric.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@finmetric.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reliability review notes + commercial proposal (SLA addendum draft attached)

Mina — appreciate the quick remediation and the proposed addendum. Two quick points:
1) The 10% credit is a reasonable start; thank you. We’ll confirm route list by Monday (priority: /v1/score, /v1/batch-score).
2) The Premium Assurance pilot pricing needs to be more flexible — FinMetric is willing to commit to a 6-month pilot but we’d like a performance SLA trial clause (if p95 > 175ms for two consecutive weeks, FinMetric can unwind pilot with a prorated credit).

If you can accept that trial clause, we can proceed with an expedited amendment and a DocuSign. Please let me know and we’ll route to Procurement.

Best,
Daniel
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Cho <cto@finmetric.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reliability review notes + commercial proposal (SLA addendum draft attached)

Daniel — we can accept the trial clause with one adjustment: the unwind window requires a joint verification run and a 5-business-day remediation opportunity before automatic unwind. This protects both sides from transient flaps. We’ll add explicit telemetry checks (shared SLO dashboard) as part of the addendum.

Action items we’ve kicked off internally:
- Ben: preparing an updated pricing worksheet with the adjustable pilot clause and a prorated credit table.
- Laura: routing the SLA addendum and pilot amendment to Legal for a fast-track review.
- Rishi: continuing profiling and will publish the runbook and expected remediation timeline by Jan 22.

If that sounds good, we’ll issue the amended addendum and a DocuSign link (HubSpot deal attached) by end of week.

Mina
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
